thread:
maya: Heads-up — several enterprise customers reporting noticeable behavior change after the model-v2 rollout ~03:05 UTC. They say the assistant now omits critical fields and adds unsolicited disclaimers. Tickets: #3245, #3249, #3251

support-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0412 and linked tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0412 :rotating_light:

maya: Example payload from Acme (trimmed):
```
PROMPT: generate invoice JSON for order 5512 with line_items and totals
EXPECTED: {
  "order_id":5512,
  "line_items":[...],
  "total": 123.45
}
ACTUAL (model-v2): {
  "summary": "Here's an invoice summary. Please consult billing.",
  "notes": "I might be mistaken. Check legal."
}
```

jorge: Can someone attach a raw request+response (headers + model metadata)? need model hash and rollout ID to correlate. Also, what's the canary % for v2?

alice: v2 was at 100% for hosted API at 03:04 UTC (rollout id r-2026-04-12-03). That explains the sudden spike. I saw customer reports starting ~03:08.

ben: Metric check: increased "assistant_addendum" occurrences and drop in structured-json-success rate on /generate route. Querying metrics now.

infra-bot: Snapshot metrics (03:00-03:20 UTC): {events: "structured_json_success: 0.58 -> 0.22", "avg_latency_ms": "127 -> 135", "error_rate": "0.7%"} (automated)

sam: We have a couple options: immediate rollback to model-v1, or try toggling conservative_template flag for v2 to force structured output. Rollback is faster. Thoughts?

jorge: Given customer impact (enterprise invoices) rollback to v1 is safest. We can investigate a fix on v2 in parallel.

maya: Agree — rollback now. Ping legal/CS to craft comms.

alice: Initiating rollback. Running command:
```
infractl rollout set --model-id model-v1 --targets hosted-api --rollout-id r-2026-04-12-03-rollback --force
```

infra-bot: Command acknowledged. Executing rollout change.

ben: Monitoring route traffic and canaries. Will post progress.

infra-bot: Rollout update: 30% -> 65% -> 100% (completed). Old model (model-v1) reinstated at 03:26 UTC.

sam: Can we confirm structured-json-success back to baseline?

infra-bot: Post-rollback snapshot (03:25-03:35 UTC): {"structured_json_success": "0.59", "avg_latency_ms": "129", "error_rate": "0.6%"}

jorge: Confirmed by quick sanity check on a few repro prompts — v1 returns expected JSON again.

tina: I'll notify impacted customers: Acme, OmniPay, FinFlow. Drafting messages now.

maya: Good. Actions: 1) CS to inform customers and offer SLA credit if needed. 2) ML team to root-cause v2 change (prompt/template drift). 3) Eng to add additional canary gating and automated structured-output tests for releases.

jorge: I'll capture diffs in model behavior and push a small eval harness: a set of 50 critical prompts (invoices, contracts, medical forms) to run on canary.

alice: Also enabling an automated alert on structured_json_success drop >10% during rollouts.

tina: Customer messages queued, will send once legal ok.

maya: Great job everyone — incident resolved for now. Follow-ups in INC-2026-0412. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Linked notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-0412?focusedCommentId=5678

ben: Leaving this thread open for postmortem. I'll collect graphs and timeline in the incident ticket.
